summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for the books extension's first hook: a bare-registered PreToolUse Write|Edit guard refusing any write that alters or deletes a line already committed in books/book-convention-evidence/NN-*.md. The plan settles the three required rulings in writing (registration into the tracked .claude/settings.json; Option B git-aware trailing-uncommitted-entry exception with an on-disk prefix-test fallback; the two-guard fail-open contract mapped onto the hook's real jq dependency surface since it sources no shared library). Phases: author hook, behavioral fixture cases, forgery probes plus fail-open plus the buried-7814-character-line case, manifest/fragment wiring, then a real deploy into the live consumer repo with independent proof of file copy, bare joined registration, and the deployed hook refusing a real evidence-file modification.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan (5.25h) for the books append-only evidence write-time PreToolUse hook, its fixture suite with forgery probes, its manifest/settings-fragment registration path, and deploy verification in the consumer repo.
